forecast.availability: exogenous x released after one period; auxiliary observations every third period released after two periods; no interpolation from future
forecast.missing: y absent when t mod 7 = 0; absence contributes no likelihood update
forecast.score: observed-row sequential Gaussian NLL; nuisance regression is ridge fit on observed training only

wallet.fit: BFGS censored Gaussian likelihood on log1p wallet; ridge excludes intercept; fixed candidate sigma

policy.selection: negative doubly robust validation value; known logger; fitted transitions/rewards use training only
policy.truth: DP and independent trajectory enumeration; optimal Markov policy and best finite threshold class reported separately

nas.fit: Adam, float64; mean value and two derivative squared errors, equal weights
nas.vector: value MSE and parameter count, with separate maximum derivative errors
nas.derivative_limits: h=0.25; limits=h*M, Mx=0.6^2*exp(0.3), Ma=0.5^2*exp(0.3); first-order interpolation derivative resolution bound

streaming.optimizer: momentum SGD with serialized weights and momentum
streaming.interruption: before third objective call; compare uninterrupted and restored trajectories

transport.target: X1=Z1; X2=Z2+0.35*(Z1^2-1), Z iid standard Gaussian
transport.model: T(z)=(z1, exp(log_scale)*z2+MLP(z1)); triangular invertible neural shear
transport.fit: exact model NLL, Adam float64; held-out NLL selection

sampler.selection: retain every pair passing fresh finite reversibility, volume and target-gradient checks; posterior discrepancies never select candidates

roles: train/validation/final are disjoint; finals refit on train+validation using seeds 1000/1001; no final observation enters searcher
methods_review: GP has four initial random draws and two acquisition restarts; TPE defaults have ten startup draws and six potential adaptive draws; ordinal indices are a declared encoding, not invariant to category ordering
inference_scope: Three data replicates; deterministic families have repeated identical fits for workflow coverage only; no power or universal superiority claim

numerical_tolerances.rationale: float64 scale-aware reconstruction; 1e-5 central difference balances O(h^2) truncation and O(eps/h) roundoff; cross-check at h/2
